ideas.title: Investigation into Minneapolis Shooting
ideas.description: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti by federal agents in Minneapolis, including the response by federal authorities and the potential for a cover-up.
ideas.angle: Police brutality and use of force by federal agents
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
What was the response by federal authorities?
Is there evidence of a cover-up?
ideas.insight: The investigation into the Minneapolis shooting has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of police brutality and misuse of force by federal agents. Further research is needed to determine the extent of the issue and the response by federal authorities.
